audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 2 through first item read 'Skill' and two items read 'Quinn'; the applied mirror sets rows 0-5 to Quinn and row 6 to Volibear. whys[4] also claimed level 6 'flips to you'.
audit.why: Quinn pokes at 1025, resets spacing with a 675-range Vault every 8-12s, and at 6 simply leaves the lane with Behind Enemy Lines. Volibear's answer arrives at two items, when a landed stun kills her outright. 44.57% for Volibear supports the shape.
audit.corrected: phases[1..5].side and win[1..5] to Quinn, phases[6].side and win[6] to Volibear; ratings 3, 3, 3, 3, 4, 3, 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] said Stormbringer 'flips the range war' at 6, which contradicts the corrected chart and ignores what her level 6 actually is.
audit.why: Behind Enemy Lines is not a lane ability — she ends the channel with Skystrike somewhere else on the map. Her 6 is a roam spike, so closing the gap in lane does not win the stage.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] and phases[4].why now say she answers Stormbringer by leaving; spikes[2] carries Vault's 10s rank-3 timer as the window.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] read 'a single Q root chains into full W executes'. Thundering Smash is a STUN, not a root, and Frenzied Maul is not an execute — it marks, applies on-hit, and heals on the re-cast into the mark. Separately the page never mentioned that Vault briefly INTERRUPTS its target on landing, or that Behind Enemy Lines is a channel.
audit.why: Two fabricated mechanics in one sentence on the most-read spike line. And the interrupt is why his walk-up keeps failing: Vault does not only reposition her, it cuts him off as it lands. The channel is the mirror image — his stun cancels her ultimate outright, which is the single best answer he owns into her.
audit.corrected: Thundering Smash: 300 range, 12s to 10s, stun plus auto reset, and being hard CC it cancels the Behind Enemy Lines channel. Frenzied Maul: 5s, marks and applies on-hit, heals on the re-cast. Vault: 675 range, 12/11/10/9/8s, dash + slow + brief interrupt, landing her at max attack range. Blinding Assault: 1025 range, 11s to 9s.

audit.why: Vault's timer is the whole lane and no number appeared on the page.
audit.corrected: Vault's 12s rank-1 and 9-10s mid-rank timers now appear in dosFull[2].d, spikes[2] and phases[3].why.

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. Quinn has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Q + W online, but Vault dashes to you, slows, briefly interrupts, and lands her back at max range — she resets the walk-up.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Quinn under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Sky Splitter slows from 1200 and shields you in the blast, but Blinding Assault hinders your vision and her Harrier hit chunks you on the way out.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Quinn down every time Vault (Dash/Blind) is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard, but Vault is back every 9s at rank 4 — you get one bite before she is at max range again.

edits.before: Stormbringer online — you can dive Quinn under tower with the disable. The 3-6 window is the strongest your lane will ever be: cash it.
edits.after: Stormbringer closes the range she lives at, yet Behind Enemy Lines lets her leave the lane entirely — she trades the lane for map pressure.

edits.before: Level 6 flips to you: R Stormbringer closes the range she depended on for kiting.
edits.after: Level 6 stays hers — Behind Enemy Lines turns the lane into map pressure.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Quinn to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Sundered Sky heals on the first hit, but you only get that hit when Vault is down — otherwise she dashes clear and keeps poking.

edits.before: Your R Stormbringer flips the range war: leap the wall or over her, land the passive slow zone, and now she can't kite the gap she relied on.
edits.after: Stormbringer closes the range she lives at, but she answers by leaving: Behind Enemy Lines flies her out and she takes the map instead.

edits.before: With your first bruiser item and Relentless Storm stacks up, a single Q root chains into full W executes before Vault comes back, but she out-trades you if you whiff the stun.
edits.after: With your first bruiser item, one landed Thundering Smash stun chains into both Frenzied Maul bites before Vault comes back at 10s — but whiff the stun and she out-trades you on the way out.

edits.before: After first item and especially with R Stormbringer online you can finally jump the range gap and Q-W burst her, but she stays a live threat in the sidelane where lethality lets her burst you if you close without your ultimate.
edits.after: By two items you can finally jump the range gap: Stormbringer's leap plus the stun into both Frenzied Maul bites kills her outright. Until then she is a live threat in the sidelane, bursting you if you close without your ultimate.

edits.before: Track Quinn's Vault (Dash/Blind): Her self-peel. Q-stun her when down. When it is down — Q-stun + all-in her.
edits.after: Behind Enemy Lines is a channel — Thundering Smash's stun cancels it. Vault interrupts you as it lands.

edits.before: Quinn wastes Vault (Dash/Blind) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Vault is down 12s at rank 1 — that is the only window she gives you.

edits.before: You spike levels 3-6 hard — that's the kill window. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.
edits.after: Your window is two items, not the lane. See the level-by-level chart for where the lane turns over.

notes: packet suspectName 'Relentless Storm' is a FALSE POSITIVE — The Relentless Storm is Volibear's real passive — but the sentence it sat in contained two genuine fabrications ('Q root', 'W executes') and is rewritten. The mirror flagged that dosFull[2].t on the Quinn page reads 'Blind (E) his engage' when her blind is Blinding Assault (Q); at 20 characters it falls under the applier's 25-char skip and needs a manual fix on that side. Newly stated here and absent before: Vault briefly interrupts its target on landing, and Behind Enemy Lines is a channel that Thundering Smash cancels.
